tpm: explicitly include tpm2 data in the appropriate section With the recent move to enabling LTO the tpm_registers module's data variables which are supposed to be cleared on TPM reset ended up not included in the appropriate part of the .bss section. With this patch all variables of interest are marked with the section name they need to be placed in. BRANCH=cr50, cr50-mp BUG=b:124450448 TEST=before this patch after RMA clear every TPM reset was wiping out the TPM NVMEM, with this patch in place only the following reset wipes out the NVMEM.
